findings.title: Actionability classification roll-up reverses one backed family into orientation-only
findings.what: The table contains 30 classified families: 19 rows marked Backed and 11 marked Orientation. The roll-up instead reports 18 Backed and 12 Orientation-only, making the audit summary arithmetically inconsistent with its evidence table.
findings.fix: Change the roll-up totals at lines 126-127 to 19 Backed and 11 Orientation-only.
findings.acceptance: Mechanically count the Class column in rows 93-122 and confirm it yields Backed=19, Orientation=11, total=30, matching the corrected roll-up.
findings.verifyNote: Adversarially re-read the complete classification table and roll-up at baseline c8b98a29508b5eb7725c75a7e2a41dfa94c1feba, then independently counted exact `| Backed |` and `| Orientation |` table cells: 19 and 11 respectively. Both counts sum to the table's 30 families, while the published 18/12 also sums to 30 but misclassifies one family.
